scientific_integrity: Analytic all-parameter proof with an exact noninteger-gradient witness, supported by reproducible finite standard-library checks. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp universal feasibility barrier concerns positive hyperbolic-tangent rate parameters in an infinite-line two-orientation velocity-jump system; it does not classify exact mode numbers or phase boundaries above g/u=2 and does not extend to arbitrary saturation profiles or thermal diffusion. A publication-priority risk from unindexed equivalent inequalities remains.
title: Sharp factor-two gradient barrier for peak proliferation in a saturating run-and-tumble particle
